title: Spicy Malaysian Chicken Soup
description: A flavorful and comforting soup inspired by Malaysian cuisine, featuring spicy chicken and ginger.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced ginger and cook for 2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the chicken breast and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the chicken broth, soy sauce, sugar, and malaysian chili paste. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the peppery soup and stir to combine.
Add the rice vinegar and stir to combine.
Simmer for an additional 5 minutes, until the soup has thickened slightly.
Serve hot, garnished with sliced ginger and a sprinkle of soy sauce.
